title: This is the noble truth of suffering
subtitle: A Four Noble Truths saying in the Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta
timeLabel: SN 56.11; transmitted first-teaching context at Sarnath
shortSummary: The short line keeps Buddhist teaching within the textual setting of the first turning at Sarnath rather than turning it into a context-free modern maxim.
curatorialDescription: Original text, version, speaker attribution and the Sarnath event are modelled separately; the Buddha's saying is marked as preserved through transmission.
researchNote: The Pāli digital edition is the research entry point. Chinese translations, parallels and a fuller passage will be added in a later textual-review batch.

quote.interpretation: This is the noble truth of suffering.

profile.translationEn: This is the noble truth of suffering.

note.zh-CN: 当前巴利语段落的英译字段使用 suffering；同一经文的 Thanissaro 英译版本使用 stress。本条只记录译者措辞差异，不把它当作巴利语底本异文或唯一释义。
note.en: The current Pāli passage uses suffering in its English field; the Thanissaro English witness uses stress. This records a translator-wording difference, not a manuscript variant or a single authorised interpretation of the Pāli.
